versions.changelog: 移除示例中的中文昵称（小文/小智/小贾），改用通用 Agent ID，确保技能通用性
改进工作流程：先列出会话并给出清理建议，由用户确认后再执行

- Initial release of amiao-session-cleaner.
- Provides tools and scripts to clean up unused OpenClaw sessions and session files.
- Supports automated removal of expired session files (.jsonl, .trajectory, .checkpoint).
- Retains active (running) sessions and main sessions for each agent.
- Includes quick cleanup script and validation steps.
- Requires a Gateway restart after cleanup for changes to take effect.
